highlights.title: Mantaflow, Houdini and LiquiGen
highlights.description: GAIA Water Flow reads a baked Mantaflow liquid, or liquid particles with velocity imported from Houdini or LiquiGen. Hydrodynamic Pressure works with all of them.

highlights.title: Wetness in the Bake window
highlights.description: Bake Wetness shows its progress, frames and time left in the Bake window, with Cancel, like a cloth bake.

highlights.title: Companion in the tray
highlights.description: On Windows the Cloth NeXt Companion runs quietly in the background, keeps your licence current and opens your account from its tray icon.
